items.source: Ruled 2026-09-02 (GEAR-DESIGN.md §4): the Waystation's common items — a fixed catalog, tier 0, unlocked by the building's bands, bought for Supplies or Mana Crystals, restocked after each Battle. | 2026-10-02: itemClass weapon -> trinket (fix.one-hero-assembly; engine SWITCHES.md netIsAPower). Two rulings meet here: "Net needs no hands. Net is just a power, and it's a one-time use." (2-ACTIONS-SETTLED.md, 2026-09-02) and "There should be no weapon that is zero-handed." (engine DECISIONS.md, 2026-09-28). Read together, the Net is not a weapon: it keeps no hands and works from its item slot, as every other Waystation one-use row does.

attacks.name: Hew
attacks.source: 2026-08-27 review: crit +2 removed.

attacks.name: Great Cleave
attacks.targets: an adjacent hex and the two hexes adjacent to both you and it
attacks.description: A hex-targeted burst affecting all units in the authored three-hex arc, dealing Strength + 1 physical damage. Standard V2 burst shielding and attenuation apply. It is not an attack.
attacks.source: | 2026-08-20: "every enemy adjacent to you" was the wrong shape. You name a hex and it hits that hex plus left and right — three attacks, same shape as attack.halberd.cleave. | V2 migration 2026-09-16 (provisional): preserve authored shape, costs, range and magnitude; explicit all-units burst, no attack hooks or rolls. Earlier description: Three hexes in one swing: the hex you name and the one either side of it. Each is resolved as its own attack, so each rolls, and each can crit.

attacks.name: Crush

triggers.effect: the target loses 1 Armor for the rest of the Battle

attacks.description: Damage is your Strength +1, plus the Stun on the target. It READS the Stun and leaves it: you hit them while they are still seeing stars and they go on seeing them.
attacks.source: 2026-08-17 design pass: the mace now adds the target's Stun, reading it — you hit them while they are still seeing stars.

attacks.name: Skullsplitter
attacks.description: Damage equals your Strength plus your Armor. The head is only as heavy as the person swinging it is willing to stand still, so the more plate you are carrying the harder it lands.
attacks.source: 2026-08-17 design pass: blended damage onto Strength + Armor and dropped the flat +3, so the heaviest, slowest fighter hits hardest instead of just hitting for a bigger printed number.

attacks.name: Thrust
attacks.targets: one enemy in melee reach and the hex directly behind it
attacks.description: The spear goes through. It hits what you aimed at and whatever is standing behind it.
attacks.source: | 2026-08-20: now hits the hex behind the target as well — that is what a spear is for.

attacks.name: Hurl
attacks.description: Throw the spear. You do not lose it — weapons are never lost to being thrown.
attacks.source: | 2026-08-20: the "you are unarmed until you recover it" clause is cut; weapons are not lost to being thrown. NOTE: that drawback WAS the attack’s whole identity, so what is left is a plain range-4 throw. If you wanted a different second attack on the hunting spear rather than a de-fanged Hurl, say so and I will replace it.

attacks.name: Sweep
attacks.targets: an adjacent hex and one hex adjacent to both you and it
attacks.description: Two hexes: the one you name and one beside it.
attacks.source: | 2026-08-20: not every adjacent enemy — the hex it targets and one to the left.

attacks.name: Impale
attacks.targets: one enemy within 2 hexes and the hex directly behind it
attacks.description: A blade on a pole reaches the row behind the row, and this is the attack that says so: the target and whatever is behind it.
attacks.source: 2026-08-20: now hits the hex behind the target as well. | 2026-08-27: the sheet RANGED marking was a typo (ruled) — stays melee.

attacks.name: Flick
attacks.source: 2026-08-27 review: damage +1 -> 0, stamina 1 -> 0.

attacks.name: Fan
attacks.source: 2026-08-27 review: 2 attacks (hits 2).

triggers.effect: apply 2 Poison to each target hit

attacks.name: Fang
attacks.source: 2026-08-27 review: TRUE damage, +1 -> 0, crit removed, onHit 20%: target loses 1 Strength.

attacks.name: Gut
attacks.source: 2026-08-20: "if the target has not yet acted this Turn" is cut — the only condition that read turn order. Folded in at half: +5 Accuracy, +5 Crit on the face. | 2026-08-27 review: TRUE damage, +3 -> +1, onHit 20%: target loses 1 Strength.

attacks.name: Twin Cut
attacks.source: | 2026-09-02 ruled: a DOUBLE ATTACK COSTS AT LEAST 2 STAMINA. Swept here from the Iron Claws ruling — Twin Cut was the only other double attack in the game priced at 1 stamina. Its DAMAGE is untouched: the -1 cut was reasoned specifically about Iron Claws being two-handed for one less than a one-hander, and Duel Runeblades carries a demon slayer on its other attack. Say so if it should take the damage cut too.

attacks.name: Rune Cross
attacks.description: The runes take light on the cross-cut: damage equals your Strength plus the party's Magic, and it lands as magic damage. Twin Cut is still the cheap physical option; this is the one a caster picks the weapon up for.
attacks.source: 2026-08-17 design pass: made the runeblade an actual spellblade — damage blends Strength with the party Magic and lands as magic damage, which gives a Mage a melee attack worth holding. | 2026-08-27 review: magic -> physical.

attacks.name: Lash
attacks.source: 2026-08-27 review: re-kinded RANGED in the sheet, but N was never stated — range null, a named gap, never a number I picked. | 2026-08-27: the sheet RANGED marking was a typo (ruled) — stays melee.

attacks.name: Hamstring

triggers.effect: apply 2 Weak and the target gains 1 Slow

attacks.source: 2026-08-20: "clean up that movement stuff." A one-Turn Movement loss is now the Slow status — apply N Slow. Fourteen entries said this two different ways and every one of them needed the engine to remember whose next Turn it was. Amount unchanged. | 2026-08-27: the sheet RANGED marking was a typo (ruled) — stays melee.

attacks.name: Rake
attacks.source: | 2026-09-02 ruled: a DOUBLE ATTACK COSTS AT LEAST 2 STAMINA. Iron Claws also had its damage cut by 1, verbatim: 'I think the Ironclaws probably have a damage that is one too high. It is already a two-handed weapon that does one less than a standard one-handed weapon... If you have a 4 strength and you are doing 1 less damage to something with 1 armor, you are doing 2 damage twice. So at 5 strength against 1 armor, it is gaining.' At Str 4 vs Armor 1 it now matches a longsword Slash exactly (4 vs 4) and only pulls ahead from Str 5 — the curve crosses where it should.

attacks.name: Eviscerate
attacks.description: Damage is your Strength +1, plus the Weak already on the target. It READS the Weak — the stacks are left where they are, so the next hit finds them too.
attacks.source: 2026-08-17 design pass: brawl attack now adds the target's Weak, reading it rather than spending it, which is the tier-1 entry to the martial-artist family.

attacks.name: Braced Thrust
attacks.source: 2026-10-04: display name Brace -> Braced Thrust. The Tower Shield's power is Brace by the Armory Ledger (approved for now 2026-09-28), and an attack and a power may not share a display name; the id is unchanged (engine item content.shields-reauthored; engine SWITCHES.md shieldPowerNames).

attacks.name: Hurl
attacks.source: | 2026-08-17: CUT. ally-reactive hooks, guarding, Consequence-Stack interference and non-knockback forced movement all removed by ruling. | 2026-08-17 design pass: blended onto Precision + Strength — aim puts it on the target and shoulder puts it through.
attacks.description: Damage equals your Precision plus your Strength. Aim puts it on the target; shoulder puts it through.

attacks.name: Spark
attacks.source: 2026-08-27 review: stamina 1 -> 0. | 2026-09-02, from the weapon outlier review: damage lowered by 1 — a 0-stamina attack does not also carry positive damage. Ruled.

attacks.name: Surge
attacks.description: Damage is the party's Magic +1, plus the Burn already on the target. It READS the Burn and leaves it burning, so the stack it found is still there next Turn.
attacks.source: 2026-08-17 design pass: the wand now adds the Burn already on the target, reading it — the cheap, safe tier-1 version of the family.

attacks.name: Read the Page
attacks.source: 2026-08-27 review: "precision dmg + 1/2 magic" — precision-stat attack whose bonus is HALF the attacker's Magic (rounds nearest, 0.5 up, per the 2026-08-25 rounding ruling). halfStatBonus is a new field; the engine lacks it — named gap.

attacks.name: Long Passage
attacks.targets: one enemy within 4 hexes and every enemy adjacent to it

attacks.name: Verse
attacks.description: Damage equals your Precision plus the party's Spirit. A priest is both halves of that and this is the weapon that pays for both.
attacks.source: 2026-08-17 design pass: the priest weapon now reads damage = Precision + Spirit, the blend the guide names, instead of Spirit alone.

attacks.name: Banishing Blow
attacks.packetInterpretation: Provisional V2: authored 'deal 6 more damage' onCrit (100%) inherits physical type and is a separately mitigated flat packet, not a bonus merged into base damage. Requires balance review.
attacks.source: 2026-08-27 review: crit +3 replaced with onCrit: +6 damage.

attacks.name: Remembrance
attacks.source: 2026-08-27 review: damage +1 -> 0.

attacks.name: Honour the Dead
attacks.source: 2026-08-27 review: damage +2 -> +1, the ally-heal clause removed — heal 3 self only.

attacks.name: Butcher
attacks.description: Damage is your Strength +2, plus every stack of Bleed on the target, which it CONSUMES — you find the cut that is already open and put the whole axe into it. It applies 3 fresh Bleed afterwards, so the clock restarts from nothing.
attacks.source: 2026-08-17 design pass: the axe now opens the wound that is already there — it consumes the target's Bleed, which is exactly what the weapon is named for.

attacks.name: Sentence
attacks.description: Damage equals your Strength plus the party's Spirit, and a further +1. The sentence is only ever as heavy as the faith standing behind it.
attacks.source: 2026-08-17 design pass: blended the finisher onto Strength + Spirit and cut the flat +4, so a Paladin swinging it in a party with a Priest hits like the name promises.

attacks.name: Aegis Slam

triggers.effect: push the target 1 hex and it gains 1 Slow

attacks.description: Damage equals your Strength plus your Armor: the shield arrives with everything you are wearing behind it.
attacks.source: 2026-08-17 design pass: blended damage onto Strength + Armor, which is what a shield attack should have been scaling off all along. | 2026-08-20: "clean up that movement stuff." A one-Turn Movement loss is now the Slow status — apply N Slow. Fourteen entries said this two different ways and every one of them needed the engine to remember whose next Turn it was. Amount unchanged.

attacks.name: Death Stroke

triggers.effect: heal 3 and gain +1 Strength for the rest of the Battle, stacking

attacks.source: | 2026-08-20: "+10 Accuracy against a target at or below half Health" read a Health threshold. Folded in unconditionally on the attack’s face.

attacks.name: Long Shot
attacks.source: | 2026-08-20: "may not be used if any enemy is adjacent to you" restates a global rule — a ranged attack may not target an adjacent unit, and firing while something is adjacent to YOU costs -20. Both live in the accuracy stations, not on one bow.

attacks.name: Venom Fan

triggers.effect: apply 2 Poison to each target hit

attacks.description: Three targets. Against each, damage is your Precision plus every stack of Poison already in it — and the fan CONSUMES that Poison, calling the whole slow dose due at once. It leaves 2 fresh Poison in each on hit, so the clock starts again from a much smaller number.
attacks.source: 2026-08-17 design pass: the fan now drinks the Poison already in each target it hits, the poison member of the status-consuming family.

attacks.name: From Behind
attacks.description: Damage is your Strength +2, plus the Bleed already on the target. It READS the Bleed — every stack stays, still ticking, and Resist never touched any of it.
attacks.source: 2026-08-17 design pass: the knife now adds the target's Bleed, reading it, so a Nightblade party has something that cashes in without turning the clock off. | 2026-08-20: "if an ally is adjacent to the target" is adjacency to the TARGET, the same check that cut enchant.catch-them-off-guard — it walks a second unit's neighbours. Condition removed. The bonus was +15 Accuracy and +10 Crit when it fired; folded in unconditionally at roughly half, so the attack now reads +8 Accuracy and +15 Crit on its face. THE SPLIT IS MINE, not dictated — say the word and I will move it.

attacks.name: Thunder Strike
attacks.description: The blade earths the storm through you before it lets go of it: damage equals your Strength plus your Resist.
attacks.source: 2026-08-17 design pass: blended onto Strength + Resist, so the blade that carries lightning wants a wielder who can hold it.

attacks.name: Reading
attacks.description: Damage equals your Precision plus half the party's Spirit.
attacks.source: | 2026-09-02b workbook: spirit+2 -> precision + 1/2 spirit, the blend the guide names.

attacks.name: Rite of Expulsion
attacks.targets: one enemy within 3 hexes and every enemy adjacent to it
attacks.description: Damage equals your Precision plus half the party's Spirit plus your own Resist: you push with the same wards that keep it off you. As an area effect it does not roll and cannot crit.
attacks.source: 2026-08-17 design pass: blended the rite onto Spirit + Resist, so warding and expelling are the same stat investment. | 2026-09-02b workbook: spirit + resist -> precision + 1/2 spirit + resist.

attacks.source: | 2026-08-17: CUT. ally-reactive hooks, guarding, Consequence-Stack interference and non-knockback forced movement all removed by ruling. | 2026-08-17 design pass: blended damage onto Strength + Magic and moved it to magic damage, so the curse is doing the work instead of a flat +4.
attacks.description: Damage equals your Strength plus the party's Magic, and a further +1, carried as magic damage — the sand goes where the curse tells it and neither of them cares how strong your arm is on its own.

attacks.name: Hellcoil

triggers.effect: apply 3 Burn to each target hit

attacks.description: Two targets. Against each, damage is your Strength +2 plus every stack of Bleed that target is carrying, and the coil CONSUMES it. It leaves 3 Burn behind in its place.
attacks.source: 2026-08-17 design pass: the tier-3 whip now consumes the Bleed on each of the two targets it reaches.

attacks.name: The Devil's Favour
attacks.source: | 2026-08-17: CUT. ally-reactive hooks, guarding, Consequence-Stack interference and non-knockback forced movement all removed by ruling. | 2026-08-17 design pass: blended onto Strength + Precision so the signature rogue knife counts both stats a Rogue actually buys.
attacks.description: Damage equals your Strength plus your Precision, as true damage. The favour is that it counts both hands of what a Rogue is instead of making you choose.

attacks.name: The King's Hands
attacks.description: Two hits. Damage is your Strength +2, plus every stack of Weak on the target — and it CONSUMES them, all of it spent in one grip. Against something nobody has softened it is an ordinary pair of gauntlets.
attacks.source: 2026-08-17 design pass: the tier-3 brawl signature now CONSUMES the target's Weak, the dramatic end of the family the iron claws start.

attacks.name: Rebuke
attacks.description: Damage equals your Precision plus half the party's Spirit.
attacks.source: 2026-08-17 design pass: blended the rebuke onto Spirit + Magic so a mixed caster party gets full value out of a priest signature. | 2026-09-02b workbook: spirit + magic -> precision + 1/2 spirit. A priest weapon should not be paying out on the party's Magic.

attacks.name: Grave Warden
attacks.description: Damage equals your Strength plus your Armor, and a further +1. A slow, heavy swing that rewards standing your ground in armour — without needing the game to check whether you moved.
attacks.source: 2026-08-17 design pass: blended damage onto Strength + Armor and removed the unconditional onAttack rider, folding it into the base numbers.

attacks.name: Siege Shot
attacks.description: Damage equals your Precision plus your Strength, and a further +1. The span has to be cranked before it will shoot, and a marksman who never lifted anything heavy will never get the full pull out of it.
attacks.source: 2026-08-17 design pass: blended onto Precision + Strength and removed the "on a Turn in which you moved" rider, which is a condition the engine cannot check.
